system: StudentHub AI — Khai Minh Motion Token Architecture

philosophy.corePriority: CLARITY > FEEDBACK > HIERARCHY > ORIENTATION > EMOTION > SPECTACLE
philosophy.narrativeSpine: From Noise to Knowledge (Hiểu Đúng. Đi Xa.)
principles: Motion explains what changed, where to look, and what is interactive.
Visual density and motion density are inversely proportional.
No functional UI transition may exceed 650ms.
CSS/SVG/DOM-first implementations must precede heavier runtime abstractions.

0.name: STATIC
0.description: Zero motion. Immediate render. Used for pure operational stability.

1.name: MICRO
1.description: Feedback states (80-150ms). Translations 2-4px. Used on Settings & Dashboard.

2.name: SUBTLE
2.description: Component transitions (180-240ms). Translations 4-8px. Used on Cards & Expert verification.

3.name: EXPRESSIVE
3.description: Section narrative flow (240-360ms). Translations 8-16px. Used on Community & Trust.

4.name: CINEMATIC
4.description: Hero & brand transition (360-520ms). Maximum 24px translation. Used exclusively on Landing Hero & Trust transition.

5.name: HERO_ONLY_EXTREME
5.description: Strictly prohibited in production to prevent visual fatigue and disorientation.

instant.use: Toggle states, immediate button active press, micro-switches

feedback.use: Hover entrance, focus ring expansion, tooltip appearance

component.use: Dropdown reveal, modal dialog scale, tab panel switch

panel.use: Drawer slide, dossier popover, sidebar expand

section.use: Scroll section entry, editorial line stagger, evidence card emergence

hero.use: Primary landing hero atmosphere, Evidence Prism light sweep entrance

maxAllowed.use: Hard ceiling for any interactive transition

standard.name: ease.standard
standard.use: Universal default for moving elements within the viewport

enter.name: ease.enter
enter.use: Elements entering the viewport or appearing from transparency

exit.name: ease.exit
exit.use: Elements exiting the viewport or fading to closed states

emphasis.name: ease.emphasis
emphasis.use: Key verified stamps, focal card emphasis, high-polish moments

linearOptical.name: ease.linearOptical
linearOptical.use: Constant-speed light sweep or continuous slow ambient drift

xs.use: Hover lift on buttons, input shift

lg.use: Hero title reveal, major headline entrance

xl.use: Full section container entrance on desktop only

heroMax.use: Maximum displacement strictly reserved for primary hero

emphasis.use: Active selected hotspot or highlighted dossier

cardMax.description: Canonical maximum blur for standard Knowledge Glass cards and panels (0–8px range)

heroCeiling.description: Global absolute ceiling reserved exclusively for top navigation bar or isolated hero modal; never applied to standard content cards

mobileMax.description: Mobile blur limit; prefer flat opaque backgrounds (rgba(18, 24, 36, 0.95)) on low-power devices

content.use: Card list items, evidence citations list

maxSequence.use: Hard ceiling for total sequenced delay

medium.use: Interactive focus and active verification state

rules: All continuous animations (particles, orbits, sweeps) pause immediately.
Transition durations compress to <= 150ms with opacity crossfade only.
Content remains 100% visible and interactive without animation playback.
Pointer tracking and parallax disabled completely.

mobileLowPower.trigger: Viewport width < 768px OR coarse pointer input
rules: No cursor-following or magnetic pointer attractions.
No multi-plane parallax or independent layer scroll speeds.
Max motion intensity capped at 1-2 across all routes.
Backdrop-filter stacks limited to a single layer.

frameBudget.offscreenPolicy: Pause all animations via IntersectionObserver when offscreen.

blurPolicy.mobilePreference: 0–4px or solid opaque layer to eliminate mobile GPU composite stalls
